title: THE PROMISE CAN CHANGE SHAPE
passages: Some days I missed the goal. Some days I needed rest. Household chores and storm cleanup still happened. The ordinary logistics of life kept interrupting the transformation montage.

I began learning how to adjust without treating every adjustment as defeat. A smaller practice could still count. Guidance from a friend could help. Mobility mattered. Preparation mattered. The handstand was becoming a lesson in how to continue a life, including the days that never looked impressive on camera.

reflections.prompt: What would continuing look like on a hard day?
Write a smaller version of a promise you have made to yourself. What would still count on a difficult day?
Try the smaller promise once. Notice whether it leaves you more willing to return.
